service.ur: تصدیق شدہ رپورٹ کارڈ کا اجرا

about: Get an attested report card for one academic year at a private or charter school in Abu Dhabi, with optional Foreign Ministry attestation.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Only for report cards published from 2012 onwards
fees: 300 AED optional Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
